ownRead.title: Noise-assisted patterning model
ownRead.description: Numerical excitable-chemical-media dynamics show an intermediate noise regime with enhanced spatial periodicity.
ownRead.statement:
## E04 — Noise-induced spatial periodicity in excitable chemical media

**simulation · component · claims C0.**

**Reported result:** Numerical excitable-chemical-media dynamics show an intermediate noise regime with enhanced spatial periodicity.

**Already supplied:** An Oregonator-type reaction model, diffusion, parameter choices and noisy forcing are specified.

**Limit of the RRG connection:** This is a numerical result, not a laboratory observation of the primordial background. Noise acts through existing nonlinear dynamics.

**Source:** Matjaž Perc (2005), *Chemical Physics Letters 410, 49–53*. [DOI: 10.1016/j.cplett.2005.05.042](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cplett.2005.05.042).

**Verification coverage:** Primary publisher record and abstract; equations and simulation data not independently reproduced. Checked 2026-10-02.
